parent_objective: implement source-balanced boundary export/tooling without weakening robustness thresholds
blocked_by: M1083 has valid success-drop rows but post-export robustness is duplicate/source dominated
invalidates: post-filtering M1083's six accepted robustness physical pairs as if it were source-diverse
running another full retarget before source-budget tooling exists

public_gates: M1086 must not use private holdout
M1086 must preserve existing robustness thresholds
M1086 must include unit tests for source-budget and balanced-selection helpers
M1086 may run only synthetic/tooling smoke, not a full new research mining run
forbidden_shortcuts: do not lower min physical pairs or max pair dominance thresholds
do not mark rows source-diverse by changing the robustness physical-pair key
do not use balanced tooling output as a promoted driver result

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: implements the source-budget and source-balanced export helpers required before another full surface refresh
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: infrastructure only; no driver training, no PPO, no promotion, no private holdout
stop_condition: stop if implementation weakens robustness thresholds
stop if implementation redefines physical-pair diversity instead of preserving robustness keys
stop if tests cannot show source-balanced selection differs from global top-K
stop if implementation requires a full new mining run to validate basic tooling
fallback_plan: if helpers pass tests, route to a small source-budget smoke over existing M1083 artifacts
if existing relocation cannot be reused safely, split out a narrower helper-only milestone
if eligible diversity is absent in existing artifacts, route to sampler expansion design
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1085 admitted source-balanced boundary tooling implementation

hypothesis: A tested source-budget and source-balanced export layer can prevent boundary relocation output from being dominated by a few physical pairs without weakening the downstream robustness gate.
success_criteria: source-balanced boundary tooling module or equivalent helpers are implemented
tests cover source budget, balanced candidate selection, dominance caps, and fail-closed classification
raw and balanced export artifact schema is documented
existing robustness thresholds and physical-pair key semantics remain unchanged
no training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, or full new research mining run occurs
failure_criteria: implementation only post-filters a six-pair accepted set
tests are missing for the new selection/budget semantics
training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, or a full new mining run starts
decision_rule: M1086 may only implement and test source-balanced boundary tooling. It cannot train, run PPO, promote, use private holdout, weaken thresholds, or claim driver progress.
